name: ca-study
description: Evidence-first crypto buy ratings with a five-line verdict, near-term meme/launchpad catalysts, early application valuation opportunities, and holder risk analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Crypto entries, meme catalysts, and early valuation gaps
interface.longDescription: Every asset assessment ends with a five-line A/B/C/D/F verdict, emoji risk/reward and entry strategy. Memes focus on next-week catalysts and 1-2 month breakout opportunities, including launchpad support and control risks. Early applications use relative valuation and expectation-trade scoring to assess small entries before full delivery, while retaining holder-profit, launch-bundle, liquidity and integrity checks.
defaultPrompt: 分析这个 CA：发射台、主池、配对资产、合约权限、团队与风险。
查币股配对是否官方，分红是否真实，并介绍底层股票。
结合当前市值评级：Meme 看未来一周催化、1–2 个月机会和发射台支持；早期应用比较同类估值，评估小仓买预期；最后以五行文本给出评级、赔率和买入策略。
